part.label: Latch Arm With Clearance Constraint
part.description: A fixed wall and a flexing latch arm positioned near it, with a `clearance` constraint asserting the arm has at least 0.3mm of gap to move freely without rubbing the wall -- unlike a `dimension` constraint (checked against already-authored numbers), this needs each component's fully resolved world position, so it's only evaluated by the brepjs generator, not by validatePrintSpec/validate_printspec.

components.description: Flexing latch arm, positioned with a deliberate 0.4mm air gap from the wall (comfortably above the 0.3mm minimum below) so it can move without rubbing.

constraints.description: The latch arm must clear the wall by at least 0.3mm to flex freely without rubbing.
